Reflector Judgment:
The Router's observation of the 'waxy' horn tip is critical. AI models often fail to render the transition from soft fur to hard keratin realistically, resulting in a smooth, plastic-like appearance. Looking at the image, the right horn tip does indeed lack the fine striations seen in real photography, appearing slightly melted. The edge bleeding is minimal and likely due to depth-of-field simulation, which is acceptable. The severity ratings by the Router are appropriate; these are minor textural flaws, not structural failures. The image is significantly better than Reference 2 (mid-quality hammerhead with obvious artifacts) and comparable to or slightly better than Reference 3 (high-quality bird) in terms of structural integrity, though the horn texture prevents a perfect score.
